$comment: The chapter manifest. Single source of truth for chapter order, numbering, titles, groups and status. scripts/build-guide-search.mjs and scripts/build-guide-all.mjs read it; the per-page sidebar TOCs are checked against it. Adding a chapter: add an entry here, add guide/<slug>.html, rerun both scripts.
